title: The Kybalion
author: Three Initiates
description: A study of the Hermetic Philosophy of Ancient Egypt and Greece, presenting seven universal principles that underpin all of reality.
curator_note: One of the most important texts ever written on the Hermetic tradition. Begin here.

title: Corpus Hermeticum
author: Hermes Trismegistus
description: The foundational texts of Hermeticism, attributed to the legendary Hermes Trismegistus. A direct path to gnosis.

title: The Secret Doctrine
author: Helena Petrovna Blavatsky
description: Blavatsky's magnum opus synthesising Eastern and Western esoteric traditions into a grand cosmological framework.
curator_note: Challenging but essential. Read volume one first.

title: The Book of the Law
author: Aleister Crowley
description: The central sacred text of Thelema, received by Crowley in 1904. Requires discernment.
curator_note: Context and readiness are essential before approaching this text.
